import hashlib,json,pathlib,sqlite3,sys,tempfile
attempts={'socket':0}
def deny_socket(event,arguments):
    if event.startswith('socket.'):
        attempts['socket']+=1
        raise AssertionError('forbidden_socket')
sys.addaudithook(deny_socket)
from card_market_tracker.alerts import application as p8a,storage as p8a_storage
from card_market_tracker.alerts.errors import OutboxError
from card_market_tracker.telegram_delivery import application as p8b,storage as p8b_storage
from card_market_tracker.telegram_delivery.errors import DeliveryError
from card_market_tracker.watchlist_alerts import storage as p8c_storage
ids={'wsig1_':'wsig1_d9f9c7f0d4ca8767a6cdb9a917cc27a61c369cecea629c790ed42fd4421bf4f0','walt1_':'walt1_6bd35f464dd126efb7f31ef6070ea7d3257799d294d5dd3dea21c3445ef0a1af'}
observations=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cmt-p8c-qa-prior-boundaries-') as temporary:
    root=pathlib.Path(temporary)
    captures,journal,outbox,ledger=[root/name for name in ('captures.sqlite','journal.sqlite','outbox.sqlite','ledger.sqlite')]
    assert len({p.resolve() for p in (captures,journal,outbox,ledger)})==4,'distinct_paths'
    p8c_storage.initialize(outbox,timeout=5)
    original=outbox.read_bytes()
    initial_names=sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir())
    with sqlite3.connect(outbox.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as db:
        assert db.execute('PRAGMA application_id').fetchone()[0]==0x434d5459,'genuine_cmty_application_id'
        assert db.execute('PRAGMA user_version').fetchone()[0]==1,'genuine_cmty_user_version'
        assert db.execute('SELECT owner FROM watchlist_alert_metadata').fetchone()[0]=='card-market-tracker.watchlist-alert-outbox','genuine_cmty_owner'
    db.close()
    def reject(label,action,error_type,expected):
        try:
            action()
        except error_type as error:
            assert error.category==expected,'wrong_rejection_category'
            observations.append({'check':label,'error_category':error.category})
        else:
            raise AssertionError('prior_route_admitted_watchlist_authority')
        assert outbox.read_bytes()==original,'cmty_bytes_mutated'
        assert sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir())==initial_names,'unwanted_new_file'
        assert not any(p.exists() for p in (captures,journal,ledger)),'prior_source_or_ledger_created'
    for kind,value in ids.items():
        reject('p8a_enqueue_rejects_'+kind+'comparison_id',lambda value=value:p8a.enqueue(captures,journal,outbox,value,'local-preview',timeout=5),OutboxError,'invalid_field')
        reject('p8b_prepare_rejects_'+kind+'alert_id',lambda value=value:p8b.prepare(captures,journal,outbox,ledger,value,'cmp3:'+'a'*64,'local-preview',timeout=5),DeliveryError,'invalid_field')
    reject('p8a_verify_rejects_genuine_cmty_owner',lambda:p8a_storage.verify(outbox,timeout=5),OutboxError,'storage_schema')
    reject('p8b_verify_rejects_genuine_cmty_owner',lambda:p8b_storage.verify(outbox,timeout=5),DeliveryError,'storage_schema')
    assert attempts=={'socket':0},'socket_attempt_observed'
    result={'status':'pass','checks':observations,'check_count':len(observations),'four_distinct_paths':True,'cmty_schema_owner_verified':True,'cmty_source_bytes_preserved':True,'new_unwanted_files':0,'socket_attempts':attempts['socket'],'temporary_file_count':len(initial_names),'cmty_sha256_before_and_after':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
